messages:
marco: FYI: were opening a small dedicated pool in SA-EAST (sao-paulo) with a new SKU: rtx5000x (24GB, inference-optimized). Target go-live: Fri Jun 4 04:00 UTC.
marco: Pools: `rtx5000x-sa-primary` and `rtx5000x-sa-burst`. Initial capacity ~30 nodes across 2 AZs.
leah: Sequence will be sp-east-1a then sp-east-1b, stagger ~6h to validate telemetry. Partner preview for 4 customers the night before.
oliver: Important policy change: minimum reservation term for this pool during preview is 1 week (down from our usual monthly minimum). This is to let partners test latency and migration.
devops-bot: NOTE: No tenant VM reboots expected; rolling infra changes only. Debug traces enabled for 8% of traffic for the first 72h.
marco: Migration snippet (internal docs):
```
rwctl pools create --region sa-east --gpu rtx5000x --count 12 --pool-name rtx5000x-sa-primary
rwctl reservations allocate --pool rtx5000x-sa-primary --customer <id> --nodes 6
```
leah: Routing: new requests will prefer rtx5000x if project allows. Customers with hard SKU pins stay on their pools unless they migrate. We'll offer a one-click migrate in Console for qualifying customers.
billing-bot: Billing note: rtx5000x-dedicated will be set as a preview SKU. Customers reserving during preview will receive a usage credit if the final price is lower. Full pricing published after 2-week bake.
support-bot: Support playbook posted. Use tag `rtx5000x-rollout`. Escalation path: @support -> @oliver -> platform on-call. Canned responses for common customer questions ready.
tara: Telemetry to watch: token-level P50/P95, GPU mem headroom, kernel OOM events, and cold-start latency for 32k+ contexts. We'll enable per-pool cache warming during the partner preview window.
marco: Ops note: this pool is inference-only. Please block large-scale training quotas against `rtx5000x` while rolling out.
leah: Partner preview booked Thu Jun 3 22:00-02:00 UTC in sp-east-1a. If green, bulk rollout starts Jun 4 04:00 UTC.
oliver: We'll add an opt-in quant profile for a few open-source models during preview; automatic profiles after bake.
marco: Ill post an external customer announcement when sp-east-1a is live and drop the migration guide link. Ping me for partner whitelist.
